attributes.context: The extraction is located under Article 3, “Management Rights,” immediately before a provision describing supervisors’ duties and limited exceptions for manual labor.

extraction_text: 3.1 Management of the Company and direction of the working force, including the right to plan work and control plant operations, to hire, transfer, discipline, suspend or discharge employees for just cause, to determine skill, ability and other qualifications of employees, to relieve employees from duty because of lack of work or other legitimate reasons, to introduce new or improved production methods, and otherwise direct the working force, is vested exclusively in the Company, subject to the terms of this Agreement.

attributes.context: It appears in a partnership section that also requires the Partnership Committee to jointly develop and revise an action agenda by consensus and to meet at least once a month upon request of either the Union or the Company.

extraction_text: The Company agrees to taking steps necessary (including retraining, reassignment, attrition) to avoid layoffs out of the Bargaining Unit due to Improvements derived from the Partnership initiatives.
